findings.summary: Five copies of 'demand the absence tag, then refuse an either-absent value' (one drifted: Number() refused without demanding the tag) are one refuseEitherAbsence helper in absence-tag-storage.ts.

Strict equality was split over conditions.ts, comparisons.ts and data-comparisons.ts with kind-pair branches; strictEqualsCpp in data-comparisons.ts now holds every rule (BigInt vs number, record tables, numeric views, borrowed arrays, identities with null vs undefined).
The absent-operand probe compiled both operands of every strict comparison twice; it is now gated on operand syntax and types before any compile.
BigInt and symbol were kind branches in truthiness, typeof (twice), concatenation and String(); their traits now live in the per-kind data table with one shared typeofTag.

Inline absence predicates use slotHoldsOnlyNull and isNullable; the tagged-declaration storage steps repeated in two streams are one DataTypeRegistry.taggedDeclarationStorage; a misplaced helper no longer orphans storedPresence's comment.

Four new storage demand kinds and record joins each ended planning and were deduplicated twice with diverging keys; one ReplayStorage shared by planner and replay now records them, planning continues past them and re-plans to a fixed point.

The record-demand change check listed flags by hand and missed stored/dynamicJsonStorage (a throw instead of a replay); mergeNativeRecordStorage reports whether it changed anything, and one recordDemand builder serves both demand sites.

Joins were collected by copying arrays, numeric-slot storage was computed twice under a shadowing name, and three retypable-declaration predicates and two contextual-property resolvers existed; get-or-create joins, withDemandedNumericSlot, isRetypableDeclaration, contextualProperty and a tuple-array-storage module replace them.

Four failure-point detectors threw for 'this declaration needs one runtime object'; one oneObjectObservation computed before lowering decides it (also fixing a literal record passed twice comparing unequal).
Imported receivers got storage only at the Unsupported call fallback; the module-state planner now decides imported module state from reached uses (also fixing an imported factory re-run per use).
layoutsCompatible and the array copy/identity observations repeated checker work per site and replay; their answers are memoized per type pair.

The missing-primitive-method TypeError compiled the receiver speculatively before the fallback (exponential on chains); compileKnownDataMethod decides it from the checker and the receiver it already compiled.
Two fresh-array predicates with different members drifted; callsFreshArrayBuiltin in fresh-records.ts, with the library-declaration check, serves both.

Private copies of isAssignmentOperator, unwrapExpression and a parent walk, three wrapper-climbing loops with different wrapper sets, and six struct-field lookups by source name use syntax.ts (outermostWrapper, wrappedParent), ts.findAncestor and DataTypeRegistry.findStructField.
The custom-thenable check was exported and applied in two layers; it lives only in AsyncLowerer.refuseThenable, which every async return reaches before conversion.
lowerReturnedValue stacked separate mapped-array and typed-array result special cases; one returnedArrayProjection serves both.

Value-or-promise adoption was chained beside optional-promise adoption at two sites and missing at the third (a reaction returning T | Promise<T> failed at run time); one adoptPromiseUnion covers every adopter.
Promise<never> joined other settlement types only in race/any; settlesNever and rejectionOnlyPromiseCpp apply it to every promise sink, combinator spread and async return.
Three copies of the ICU buffer-retry protocol and a date formatter reopened on every call: one icu_buffer template and a per-thread cached UDateFormat.

BigInt bitwise repeated the two's-complement negate loop, BigInt arrays re-implemented typed-array view properties, string_substr re-derived relative_index, and bound callbacks captured an unused receiver: shared helpers and no capture.
js_bigint.hpp, js_symbol.hpp and js_template.hpp were included in every program through js_data.hpp; data:bigint, data:symbol and data:tagged-template features include them only where reached.
Namespace members and class statics are rewritten per dispatcher (compileCall, the data-method guard) rather than once in the shared unwrap.
findings.blockedBy: The shared unwrap also serves about 38 write-target sites: rewriting there would turn a refused namespace-member write into a silent one and would rewrite library namespaces such as Intl that libraryGlobal resolves by qualified name; it needs a read/write-aware canonical receiver first.

findings.summary: Record joins that appear only after an earlier join reshaped a component still cost one strict attempt each (measured: 66 of 73 attempts on one program).
findings.blockedBy: Layouts are fixed when the compiler is built, so no discovery pass can see a join its predecessor creates; removing the cascade needs a pre-lowering join analysis comparing each stored expression's record type with its contextual type, which does not exist yet.
